name: Resolution sniping: outcome known, oracle not yet settled (post-outcome bonding and certainty harvesting)
one_line: Between a knowable result and on-chain settlement, rest bids at 0.99-0.999 on the winner (or lift the last stale asks), redeem or resell at par and recycle; queue position, breadth and flip avoidance decide a 10-100 bp edge per cycle.
maturity: Established, thin and shrinking: top-100 bonding providers median 6.22% APY, best address $23.6k lifetime; window gone in crypto up/down, TradFi and Polymarket US, kept only by sports, weather, politics and the UMA-routed crypto threshold ladders
requires_ai: no; optional rules classification and unstructured-source parsing
edge: Winners' time preference: they sell certainty at 0.999 for cash now
capital: $1k-$10k to run, $10k+ to matter; each fill locks ~$1/share for 1-2 h post-whistle or 4-6 days if disputed
build_time: 2-3 weeks on an existing CLOB stack; 6-8 weeks from scratch
opportunity_size: 2,100+ markets closed on an NFL Sunday ($78M volume); taker-sell supply at >=0.99 only a few hundred to few thousand shares per market; shrinking
expected_results: median 6.22% / mean 29% APY for top-100 providers on deployed capital; guess 0.15-1.5%/month on capital, $15-145 gross at $10k
competition: 25k-175k-share 0.999 queues within minutes; wallet clusters and six-figure-PnL books
flag: none: public-information trading Allowed on both venues (E9)
validate: Two-weekend book replay from print to resolved_at: queue share x tick edge minus category flip rates; pass >=0.02%/day on 200+ fills
top_risk: Flip or dispute at 0.99-0.999 erases 100-1,000 fills; capital locked 4-6 days
solo_fit_reason: Free data, a public resolution state machine and fee-light mechanics make it cheap to build and safe to run, but the residual is 0.1c per share behind queues of 25k-175k shares that include six-figure-PnL books, so it is a cash-management sleeve on top of an existing sports or LP stack rather than a standalone business.
speed_class: execution-sensitive: queue position and breadth, oracle takes hours; print-second race belongs to file 18
results_1k: no; -$17 to +$2/month net (derived from the paper's APY band)
min_capital: ~$5k: below it VPS costs exceed the median-APY gross
capacity_ceiling: taker-sell supply at >=0.99 (hundreds to low thousands of shares per market); ~$50-100k deployed for a solo book (guess)
services: Score feeds (ESPN public JSON, The Odds API optional)
changes_made: Scope narrowed to the post-outcome window; pre-outcome harvesting, settlement-discount curve and holding rewards cross-referenced to file 14.
Category qualified as carry / tail-risk underwriting per the critic note; maturity set to Established but thin and shrinking with automatic resolution named as the cause.

Live 2026-09-28 measurements added: /v2/resolutions state machine and status vocabulary, kickoff-to-resolved minutes by sport family (soccer 243, NFL 259, esports 197, crypto 1 from endDate), 0.999 queue growth 2,649 -> 25,049 shares in six minutes, taker-sell supply 9,473 shares / 173 clips / 102 wallets on nine markets, cancelled MLB game still 'posed' after 23 h, wallet-cluster bursts, four largest >=0.99 buyers' lifetime PnL.
Fee arithmetic at the extremes (feeRate x p share of edge; zero_fees NFL; geopolitics fee-free but worst tail) and break-even flip rule vs category dispute rates.
